mcq.s: Which one of the following modes of privatisation is the most comprehensive and complete?
o: Introduction of private capital in public sector enterprises
Contracting out management of public enterprises to private parties
Transferring ownership and management to the workers
Transferring ownership and management to the private sector
mcq.x: Complete privatisation (divestiture) transfers both ownership and management of the enterprise to the private sector.

mcq.s: Match List-I with List-II: List-I A. Ministry of Industry B. Central Statistical Organisation C. Reserve Bank of India D. Ministry of Finance; List-II 1. Report on Currency and Finance 2. Economic Survey 3. Wholesale Price Index 4. National Accounts Statistics
mcq.x: WPI comes from the Office of the Economic Adviser (Ministry of Commerce and Industry), National Accounts Statistics from the CSO (now NSO), the Report on Currency and Finance from the RBI and the Economic Survey from the Finance Ministry.

mcq.s: Revenue deficit in India implies that:
o: The Government needs to borrow in order to finance its investments
The Government needs to borrow in order to finance its expenses which do not create capital assets
The Government needs to borrow only from the Reserve Bank of India
The Government needs to borrow from foreign sources
mcq.x: Revenue deficit (revenue expenditure exceeding revenue receipts) means borrowing is used to meet day-to-day expenses that create no capital assets.

mcq.s: Which one of the following situations best reflects 'Indirect Transfers' often talked about in media with reference to India?
o: An Indian company investing in a foreign enterprise and paying taxes to the foreign country on its profits
A foreign company investing in India and paying taxes to its country of origin on its profits
An Indian company purchasing tangible assets in a foreign country and selling them after their value rises
A foreign company transferring shares, where such shares derive their substantial value from assets located in India
mcq.x: An indirect transfer is the transfer of shares of a foreign entity whose value comes substantially from Indian assets (Vodafone case); the 2021 Taxation Laws Amendment withdrew retrospective tax on it.

mcq.s: In the Union Budget 2011-12, a new category of 'Very Senior Citizens' was created for Income Tax. This category covers persons of age:
mcq.x: Very (super) senior citizens are residents aged 80 years or above; senior citizens are those aged 60 to below 80.
